scope: 9 fictional goals. One sample each, domain checks plus manual semantic review required. No hosted auth, Neon or learner release.

input.goalText: Use AI to write clearer customer emails

proposal.subject: practical-ai
proposal.title: AI‑Enhanced Customer Email Writing
proposal.outcome: Draft customer emails with AI and check them against supplied facts.
proposal.reason: This plan builds foundational skills to craft clear, concise customer emails with AI assistance. It covers understanding AI strengths, writing prompts, iterative refinement, and information protection to help you communicate effectively and responsibly.
proposal.goalEvidence: Use AI to write clearer customer emails
proposal.context: Imagine you are a customer support specialist at a mid‑size SaaS company, responding to queries via email. You want to use an AI assistant to help draft replies that are clear, friendly, and accurate while ensuring any sensitive data is handled appropriately.

modules.introduction: We begin by exploring the strengths and limits of AI text generation, laying the foundation for responsible usage.
Next, we learn how to craft clear prompts that guide the AI toward producing the desired email content.
We then practice refining AI outputs through iteration, adjusting prompts or text to improve clarity and tone.
Finally, we cover verifying the information and protecting any sensitive data that appears in the email drafts.

input.goalText: Use AI to summarise my study notes

proposal.subject: practical-ai
proposal.title: Summarise Your Study Notes Efficiently with AI
proposal.outcome: Use AI to organise study notes and verify them against supplied sources.
proposal.reason: Summarising study notes helps you consolidate learning, saves time, and highlights key concepts for exams.
proposal.goalEvidence: Use AI to summarise my study notes
proposal.context: You're a student in an introductory biology course, and you have a week to prepare for a comprehensive exam. Your notes are spread across lecture slides, handouts, and textbook excerpts.

modules.introduction: Begin by exploring what AI can and cannot do when summarising information. This sets realistic expectations for the summarisation process.
Craft prompts that guide the AI to focus on main ideas, key terms, and relevant examples from your biology notes.
After generating a summary, review it against your original notes to ensure accuracy, and discuss how to keep your data secure during the process.

proposal.subject: cybersecurity
proposal.title: Spotting Phishing: Intro Practice
proposal.outcome: Recognise suspicious messages and choose independent verification in simulations.
proposal.reason: This plan introduces key concepts to help you spot phishing messages early and safely, giving you the confidence to act decisively.
proposal.context: Imagine you work in a small tech startup where the inbox is busy with frequent vendor communications. You notice a new email that looks suspicious.

modules.introduction: First, we will understand what digital risk is and how phishing fits into the broader security landscape.
Next, we will analyze sample phishing messages in a controlled simulation to practice recognizing red flags.

input.goalText: Protect my accounts with better passwords and MFA

proposal.subject: cybersecurity
proposal.title: Secure Your Accounts: Strong Passwords & MFA
proposal.outcome: Choose account protections and recovery steps in fictional settings.
proposal.reason: Strong passwords and multi‑factor authentication (MFA) are foundational safeguards that reduce the risk of unauthorized access, helping you protect sensitive information and maintain control over your online presence.
proposal.goalEvidence: Protect my accounts with better passwords and MFA
proposal.context: Imagine you run a small online shop and manage several email, banking, and e‑commerce accounts. You want to ensure each account is shielded from unauthorized login attempts, protecting customer data and business operations.

modules.introduction: Explore the basic concepts of digital risk, understanding how everyday online activities can expose sensitive information to potential threats.
Learn strategies to protect accounts, including selecting strong, unique passwords and configuring multi‑factor authentication for added protection.
